additional_candidate_pool.observed_description: 20 USDA standardized breakfast recipes; official page allows downloading and making copies; latest browser page states resource under revision for current program meal pattern requirements and nutrition standards.
additional_candidate_pool.retrieval_notes: Web PDF fetch rejected 40,502,924-byte document as too large. Ordinary curl retrieval via CDN and agency domain failed TLS. Browser successfully reached official page and began PDF loading; no validated local document/hash at this audit point. No candidate ingredient or rights clearance inferred.
additional_candidate_pool.feasibility_limit: This is a bounded screen, not proof that no compliant 30-recipe corpus exists. Current exact-source and market-evidence gates remain unproven; no authoritative data was changed to compensate.
